timeline.narration: Forest fire detected near Chamoli district.
Analyzing terrain: dense pine forest, dry conditions, moderate slope.
Wind analysis: NE direction at 15 km/h. Predicting spread cone...
2 villages within 3km spread projection. Evacuation advisory recommended.
Nearest fire station: Chamoli, 12km. Aerial support recommended.
Coordinating ground teams + helicopter dispatch to Dehradun airbase.
Historical data: This location had 12 fires in past 5 years. High recurrence zone.
Multi-agency response coordinated. Real-time tracking active.
